definitions.explanation: A condition in which the heart cannot pump blood effectively enough to meet the body's needs. A serious illness and a frequent cause of death listed in news reports and obituaries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心不全|しんふぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather died of heart failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{心不全|しんふぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}した→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧。
examples.english: He was hospitalized with acute heart failure.

notes:
Compound of {心|しん} (heart) + ⟦{不全|ふぜん}→不全：28173_fuzen⟧ (insufficiency/failure of an organ). The ⟦{不全|ふぜん}→不全：28173_fuzen⟧ element appears in many medical condition names: {腎|じん}⟦{不全|ふぜん}→不全：28173_fuzen⟧ (kidney failure), ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦{不全|ふぜん}→不全：28173_fuzen⟧ (respiratory failure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急性|きゅうせい}→急性：09015_kyuusei⟧{心不全|しんふぜん}: acute heart failure
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{心不全|しんふぜん}: chronic heart failure
- {心不全|しんふぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to die of heart failure
- {心不全|しんふぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to develop heart failure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}→心筋梗塞：20487_shinkinkousoku⟧: myocardial infarction; heart attack — a specific event (blocked artery), often a cause of heart failure
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}{病|びょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧: heart disease — broad umbrella term that includes heart failure
